mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% (FEDFUNDS < 4.0) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL > 3.5) signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate decline (UNRATE change < 0.0) and non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS change > 0.0) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1300 thousand units (HOUST > 1300) during strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: housing boom during strong GDP expansion
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of regime periods, or Rank IC for regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales decline exceeding 0.5% month-over-month (RSAFS change < -0.5) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (RSAFS change < -0.5), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% (INDPRO growth < 0.5) indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (INDPRO growth < 0.5), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
